patches.name: Proxy
patches.description: Routes all of the app's traffic through your HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy, with optional username and password. Set it up in the app: long-press the app icon → Proxy settings (the login is entered there, never baked into the APK). Nothing goes direct, even if the proxy is down, unless you turn on "Run without proxy" there.

options.title: Proxy host (optional)
options.description: Starting value. Hostname or IP address of the proxy, for example proxy.example.com. You can also leave this empty and set it in the app (long-press the app icon → Proxy settings). Until a proxy is set, the app has no internet.

options.title: Proxy port
options.description: Starting value. For example 443 for an HTTPS proxy, 8080 for a plain HTTP proxy, or 1080 for SOCKS5.

options.title: Proxy type
options.description: Starting value. HTTPS: the connection to the proxy itself is encrypted (such as Caddy forward_proxy). HTTP: a plain HTTP proxy. SOCKS5: a SOCKS5 proxy (not encrypted).
